content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The core of this infrastructure lies in its decentralization, enabling you to operate an online store independently of conventional payment platforms. In regions like Kenya, where financial services are often restricted, this framework allows creators to control every aspect of their sales process. By utilizing blockchain technology and secure cloud hosting, you eliminate the issues related to payment rejections and currency instability. This architecture not only provides immediate payment verification through cryptocurrencies but also ensures that your digital products remain accessible to a global audience. With COREMERCH, you take charge of your finances, product delivery, and data ownership.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you embark on deploying your ebook selling platform, you need several components. First, a digital wallet that supports cryptocurrencies is essential for receiving payments. Next, you should have your ebooks prepared, formatted, and ready for upload. Familiarize yourself with GitHub or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your online store. Additionally, consider using Google Sheets or Supabase for managing your product orders. It’s beneficial to have a basic understanding of blockchain payments, as this knowledge will aid in troubleshooting and optimizing your infrastructure. Lastly, ensure you have a reliable internet connection to facilitate seamless deployment and management.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by choosing NOWPayments as your payment processor. This allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Integrate this with your chosen hosting service, whether it's GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, to manage your product listings. Next, configure webhook notifications to ensure that you receive instant alerts when payments are confirmed. For product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring your ebooks are securely stored and readily accessible to customers after purchase. With the payment and delivery pipeline in place, you can ensure a smooth transaction process for your buyers.
Take control of your sales process today.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery systems are configured, it's time to go live. Launch your online store and publicly share your links through social media, blogs, or any relevant platforms. To process your first transaction, simulate a purchase to verify that every aspect of your infrastructure works flawlessly. Ensure that the payment confirmation from NOWPayments triggers the delivery of your ebook to the customer's email or storage link. Monitor the transaction for any issues that may arise. Once you've confirmed everything operates correctly, you can open your store to the public and confidently start selling your ebooks.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your online store, consider strategies for scaling your operation. First, analyze your sales data to identify popular products and adjust your offerings accordingly. You can add more ebooks or digital products based on customer feedback and market demand. To enhance your infrastructure further, consider utilizing Cloudflare Workers for more advanced backend logic, improving load times and user experience. Marketing your store through targeted campaigns can also help reach a larger audience. Finally, utilize the Complete Builder Kit for additional resources and templates to refine your existing infrastructure and expand your digital store.

Selling ebooks from Kenya is entirely feasible without Stripe. By leveraging a blockchain-based payment system, you can set up an online store that allows for complete control over your transactions. Utilize tools like Google Drive for delivery, coupled with NOWPayments for automated cryptocurrency transactions. This method ensures you retain ownership and independence from conventional payment processors, making your sales process seamless and secure.
No third-party dependence, complete independence.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Set up a cryptocurrency wallet to receive payments. 2. Prepare your ebooks, ensuring they’re formatted correctly. 3. Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Implement NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. 5. Utilize Google Sheets or Supabase for order management. 6. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure product delivery. 7. Test your payment and delivery systems with a simulated transaction. 8. Launch your store and promote it via social media and other channels.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, enabling you to accept various digital currencies with low transaction fees.
How do I manage my product inventory?
You can manage your product inventory using Google Sheets or Supabase, which can be integrated into your hosting platform for seamless order tracking.
Is my data secure with this infrastructure?
Yes, you retain full ownership of your data and products. This infrastructure is designed to prioritize your security and independence.
Can I scale my store easily?
Absolutely. Once your infrastructure is running, you can easily add more products and utilize advanced tools for better performance.
How do I handle customer support?
You can manage customer support through email or a dedicated section on your website, offering prompt assistance for any inquiries.
